Definition: to break in pieces, i.e. (usually without violence) to split, distribute
BiblicalUsage: Pâraç is to break in pieces, to divide, to split. The fast God chooses is to deal thy bread to the hungry and bring the poor into thy house; the clean animal is the one that divideth the hoof and cheweth the cud; and a song of praise pleases the LORD better than an ox that divideth the hoof.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the same splitting teaches two lessons: divide your bread for the hungry, and know the signs of the clean — and praise is better than either sacrifice.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
